stem.text: The diagram shows the structure of a virus.

stem.alt: Outline drawing of a virus with a central coiled structure inside a rounded outer layer studded with projections; labelled 1 and 2 with leader lines.

stem.text: Which row identifies the correct description of the structures labelled 1 and 2?

A.text: protein coat called the capsid; virus envelope made from phospholipids

B.text: virus envelope made from phospholipids; protein coat called the capsid

C.text: virus envelope made from protein; phospholipid coat called the capsid

D.text: phospholipid coat called the capsid; virus envelope made from protein
